title: Diffusion-Based Synthetic Pretraining for Root Segmentation in Rhizotron Images
mechanism: LoRA + ControlNet + inpainting generate root images with paired masks; segmenter pretrained on synthetic then fine-tuned on real; Soft Dice against 7-annotator consensus.
adaptation: Copy the schedule: pretrain U-Net++ on generated EL pairs from the best generator, then PF fine-tune on 478 real. Its Soft Dice vs multi-annotator consensus is a template for the benchmark's crack metric using our double-annotated cells.
min_experiment: Synthetic-pretrained then PF vs PF. Metric CV crack relF1@2 and E1 relF1@2. Kill: both < +0.01. About 10 GPU-h once pairs exist.
evidence: R: synthetic-only Dice up to 0.60; pretrain + fine-tune 0.80; helped unseen crop species with few labels; models matched human agreement on low-ambiguity patches only.
